title: The DLP Cinema® S2K Chipset: Converting The Uncertain Dream Of Digital Cinema Into A Future Reality For Even More Theatres In The U.S. And Around The Globe
主要内容: Texas Instruments, through its subsidiary DLP Cinema, announced the S2K chipset, optimized for theatre screens up to 20 feet wide, designed for 2D and 3D presentations. The chipset meets DCI specifications for image quality, color, and security, enabling greater versatility. The S2K, based on the same core technology as DLP Cinema's 2K and 4K chipsets, is part of Texas Instruments' expansion into digital cinema solutions. DLP Cinema is expanding its digital cinema solutions to support more theaters in the U.S. and globally, including China and India. The company emphasizes its commitment to helping exhibitors transition to digital projection. The S2K chipset will be integrated into projectors by Barco, Christie, and NEC, which are DLP Cinema's OEM licensees. Pre-production versions of the S2K chipset have been delivered to these licensees, with production-ready versions expected later this year. S2K-powered projectors are anticipated to be available for ordering and installation soon after. The S2K chipset aims to replace expiring VPF models, offering a cost-effective alternative for digital cinema adoption.
